pluginDescription: View and connect your concepts on a canvas.
pluginDocumentation: Nesso Graph displays the current view. Drag concepts to arrange them, connect them, and select items to edit them in the Inspector. Canvas controls share the document's undo and redo history.
nodeInstructions: Press Enter or Space to select a concept. Use the arrow keys to move it, Delete to remove it, or Escape to clear the selection.
nodeSelectionInstructions: Press Enter or Space to select a concept. Press Delete to remove it or Escape to clear the selection.
nodeMoved: Concept moved. New position, x: {{x}}, y: {{y}}
relationInstructions: Press Enter or Space to select a relation. Press Delete to remove it or Escape to clear the selection.
